Warnakulasooriya Madduma Muthukalage Amila Prasad Siriwardana (born 21 June 1983) is a Sri Lankan politician, social activist, and member of parliament. He was elected to the Sri Lankan Parliament in the 2024 General Election, representing the Gampaha Electoral District as a member of the Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB).He is also a strong advocate for establishing  free market economy and  open economy in Sri Lanka.
Early life and education
Amila Prasad Siriwardana was born and raised in Gampaha District, Sri Lanka. He completed his secondary education at Bandaranayake Central College, Veyangoda and pursued higher education at the University of Kelaniya. He graduated with a Bachelor of Science (BSc) degree.
Political career
Siriwardana entered politics as a member of the Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB), a center-right political party in Sri Lanka. In the 2024 General Election, he contested from the Gampaha Electoral District and was successfully elected to the 17th Parliament of Sri Lanka. He secured his seat by obtaining 23,699 preferential votes.
In Parliament, Siriwardana has been actively advocating for policies focused on education reform, economic empowerment, and good governance. He has also emphasized the importance of transparency and accountability in politics.
Advocacy and community engagement
Siriwardana is well-known for his community engagement initiatives. Before entering Parliament, he worked on grassroots projects aimed at improving educational opportunities for underprivileged children in the Gampaha District. As a member of parliament, he continues to support programs that address socio-economic disparities in the region.
Personal life
Siriwardana is actively involved in public speaking and mentoring programs for youth. He resides in Mirigama.
